description.en: Agent preset distribution plugin delivering an "探索模式" (Explorer) preset as a bundle-patch @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset declaration line: installing it adds the preset to the picker, with no disk sync. Routing is keyed by model id, not by channel — DeepSeek V4 Flash sessions get a weak persona branch (classification, review, anti-drift, deep-thinking and decision-closure guidance) and a narrowed first-turn tool face (read/write/edit plus the platform shell); after the first tool/call the full 28-row catalog is exposed. The deepseek, longcat and third-party families keep the full catalog from the first turn; third-party guidance is configurable (classify or neutral).
description.zh: 以 bundle 补丁层交付的 agent preset「探索模式」：安装即声明 @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset 行，预设进入选择器，无任何落盘同步。按模型 id 命中、渠道无关——DeepSeek V4 Flash 走 weak persona 分支（分类、回顾、反跑题、深度思考、决策闭环），首轮工具面收窄为 read/write/edit 加平台 shell，首次 tool/call 后放开 28 行全目录；deepseek / longcat / 第三方家族首轮不收窄，第三方引导方式可配置（classify 或 neutral）。
